newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli adviser flies to Amman.
newsitem.headline: Israeli adviser flies to Amman.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's political adviser flew to Amman on Sunday to brief Jordan's King Hussein on peace developments, Israel Radio said.
It said the king sent a helicopter to Jerusalem to pick up the adviser, Dore Gold, who would return to Israel before the start of the Jewish holy day Yom Kippur at sunset.

Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin in 1994 signed a peace treaty with Jordan, which of all of Israel's Arab peace partners has maintained the closest relations with Netanyahu's right-wing government since its election in May.
